description: An open-source toolkit based on the emergent_open_source_breakthrough enables small firms and municipalities to run sophisticated AI-driven grid optimisation, but with minimal oversight. Several regional energy providers adopt it, leading to uncoordinated feedback loops that destabilise local load balancing. Regulators issue urgent warnings, and a voluntary pause is called in three countries. The episode exposes the fragility of distributed, sovereign AI adoption when assurance lags.
